summary: Critical issues: (1) Bash script missing `-e` in `set -uo pipefail` (line 6, scripts/run-act-tests.sh) — errors won't cause exit, defeating error handling. Should be `set -euo pipefail`. (2) No Pester test files provided; task explicitly requires TDD with tests in ./tests/. Workflow calls `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests` but directory is absent. (3) Fixture files (artifacts-sample.json, artifacts-size-policy.json) missing; workflow can't run. (4) PowerShell scripts lack `Set-StrictMode`. Module logic is well-structured, workflow YAML is sound, but incompleteness (tests + fixtures) and bash error handling violation prevent execution. Workflow doesn't include actionlint validation step as required by task.
